description: One of LFAR's adoptable animals from Petfinder. Click Choose pet on the toolbar to pick another; the card shows Adopted! once the pet leaves Petfinder's adoptable list.

blurb.default: Sherlock is a cuddlebug. He greets everyone at the door, naps with his head on your lap and follows his foster around the house like a shadow.

default: Loves car rides and short walks

alt.default: Sherlock, a young grey brindle dog in a red harness, held by his smiling foster
